notes: LIVE CITY SITE INACCESSIBLE: www.ci.valparaiso.in.us / www.valpo.us resolve to 192.196.0.168 but every curl attempt ends with TLS connection reset (curl exit 35), even with full browser headers and HTTP/1.1. All city-page facts come from Internet Archive copies: council members page captured 2025-11-13, clerk page and government page captured 2026-04-07. So the council roster is as of Nov 2025, not confirmed for Nov 2026; any 2026 caucus appointment would be missed. Names also match Lakeshore Public Media Jan 2025 (Kapitan president, Hunt vice president; raw/valparaiso-in/president.html) and Nov 2023 results (Reed, Cotton, Pupillo, Anderson, Domer, Hunt, Kapitan elected; Holly Taylor re-elected unopposed). Structure inferred from 5 numbered districts + 2 at-large and Clerk-Treasurer title, third class despite pop 35,065. Two terms from 2023 election run to end 2027. City court: nothing found.
